config.design: 96 heldout task contrasts, four discovery items per task/control/axis/setting. Seven modes: native/exact/new-wording own/cross-wording same-task/copy/constant/original other_tasks. Cross-wording and other-task means frozen in H654; same seed654 probes. Three seeded orthonormal unit probes injected directly after block9. Receiver attention, normalization and readout fixed; substitute MLP context shift throughout10-17. No output fitting.
config.limitations: Direct block9 probes differ from prior block5-propagated probes. Local derivative counterfactual, not finite behavioral change. Known task identity, second task phrasings, same item splits. Length changes reported; no semantic invariance presumed. Native competence evaluated separately.
